message.content: /deep-research Please list all the people who were added to the FBI's Most Wanted list in 2000 or 2001 who were convicted of murder within the ten years after their placement on the list.

input.content:
# Research Plan: FBI Most Wanted 2000-2001 Additions Convicted of Murder Within 10 Years

## Goal
Identify all individuals added to the FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list in 2000 or 2001 who were subsequently convicted of murder within 10 years of their placement on the list.

## Components
1. **List Identification** - Complete list of individuals added to FBI Ten Most Wanted in 2000 and 2001
2. **Case Outcomes** - For each person, determine capture/resolution details and conviction records
3. **Murder Conviction Verification** - Confirm murder convictions within 10-year window post-placement
4. **Timeline Verification** - Ensure conviction dates fall within 10 years of list addition

## Constraints
- Only include those added in calendar years 2000 or 2001
- Only include murder convictions (not just charges or other crimes)
- Conviction must occur within 10 years of list placement date
- Must be verified from authoritative sources (FBI, court records, reputable news)

## Queries

### Query 1 (High Depth) - 2000 Additions
**Component**: List Identification
**Search**: FBI Ten Most Wanted Fugitives additions 2000 complete list who was added

### Query 2 (High Depth) - 2001 Additions
**Component**: List Identification
**Search**: FBI Ten Most Wanted Fugitives additions 2001 complete list who was added

### Query 3 (High Depth) - Case Outcomes 2000
**Component**: Case Outcomes
**Search**: FBI Most Wanted 2000 additions capture conviction murder sentencing outcome

### Query 4 (High Depth) - Case Outcomes 2001
**Component**: Case Outcomes
**Search**: FBI Most Wanted 2001 additions capture conviction murder sentencing outcome

### Query 5 (Medium Depth) - Verification
**Component**: Murder Conviction Verification
**Search**: FBI Ten Most Wanted convicted murder within 10 years 2000 2001

Based on my research of all 10 individuals added to the FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list in 2000 and 2001, **five** were convicted of murder within 10 years of their placement:

## Individuals Meeting the Criteria

| Name | FBI # | Date Added | Murder Conviction Date | Within 10 Years |
|------|-------|------------|------------------------|-----------------|
| **Jesse James Caston** | 459 | Aug 19, 2000 | Aug 16, 2004 (second-degree murder, Crosby plea) | ✅ Yes |
| **Aurlieas Dame McClarty** | 461 | Feb 24, 2001 | May 7, 2008 (two counts first-degree murder) | ✅ Yes |
| **Francis William Murphy** | 464 | Jun 6, 2001 | Aug 4, 2003 (five counts second-degree murder) | ✅ Yes |
| **Dwight Bowen** | 465 | Aug 30, 2001 | Feb 19, 2004 (two counts second-degree murder) | ✅ Yes |
| **Felix Summers** | 468 | Oct 30, 2001 | Nov 13, 2006 (first-degree murder) | ✅ Yes |

## Individuals Added in 2000–2001 Who Did NOT Meet Criteria

| Name | FBI # | Date Added | Reason |
|------|-------|------------|--------|
| Eric Franklin Rosser | 460 | Dec 27, 2000 | Convicted of child pornography, not murder |
| Hopeton Eric Brown | 462 | Mar 17, 2001 | Killed in gunfight with Jamaican police (2004); no trial/conviction |
| Maghfoor Mansoor | 463 | May 23, 2001 | Killed by police in hotel lobby (2001); no murder conviction |
| Nikolay Soltys | 466 | Aug 23, 2001 | Committed suicide in jail (2002) before trial |
| Clayton Lee Waagner | 467 | Sep 21, 2001 | Convicted of anthrax hoaxes, firearms, escape, theft—not murder |

## Sources
- FBI Ten Most Wanted 401–500 list: https://www.fbi.gov/wanted/topten/ten-most-wanted-fugitives-faq/ten-most-wanted-401-500
- Wikipedia "FBI Ten Most Wanted Fugitives, 2000s": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FBI_Ten_Most_Wanted_Fugitives,_2000s
- Individual case records from court opinions (FindLaw, Justia, Casemine), FBI press releases, and contemporaneous news coverage (CNN, Orlando Sentinel, Chicago Tribune, Philadelphia Inquirer, LA Times, Jamaica Observer) as cited in the delegation transcripts.
